title: RPM Offices Closed - Labor Day
summary: Resource Property Management offices are closed on Labor Day, September 7. For emergencies, call 727-581-8729 and press 9.
public_detail: Monday, September 7 | Resource Property Management offices are closed today in observance of the Labor Day holiday. If you have an emergency on the common areas of your community, please contact the office by calling 727-581-8729 and press 9 to be connected to our After-Hours Emergency Services Department. The on-call maintenance member will answer or return your call promptly to assist you with the reported emergency issue.
